data.exact_reserve_text: A surplus run-off amount of GBP 3.5m was experienced in 2018 (2017: GBP 18.1m surplus). This was made up of a surplus on the prior year claims provisions of GBP 1.7m on direct business (2017: GBP 22.5m surplus) and a GBP 1.8m surplus on reinsurance accepted business (2017: GBP 4.4m deficit).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a favourable prior-year development in 2018 with a total surplus run-off of GBP 3.5m, comprising a GBP 1.7m surplus on direct business and a GBP 1.8m surplus on reinsurance acceptances. Gross claims outstanding reduced from GBP 111.035m at 1 January 2018 to GBP 87.928m at 31 December 2018. The movement is attributed to favourable claims development across the run-off portfolio.
raw_causal_phrases: A surplus run-off amount of GBP 3.5m was experienced in 2018 (2017: GBP 18.1m surplus).
a surplus on the prior year claims provisions of GBP 1.7m on direct business
a GBP 1.8m surplus on reinsurance accepted business

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development taken from Note 10 narrative which explicitly states a GBP 3.5m surplus run-off in 2018 and the split between direct business (GBP 1.7m) and reinsurance acceptances (GBP 1.8m). The note is presented alongside the gross claims reconciliation so the amounts are treated as gross movements. No detailed gross prior-year movement table (labelled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding') or claims development triangle was provided to further disaggregate older underwriting years. Direct business prior-year movement is only given as an aggregate across direct classes, so 'Aggregate' was used for mapping. No specific named catastrophe events affecting prior years are cited in the reserve movement narrative.
